action.body: Please upload the full carton with DL-021 marking and a close view of the dented corner through the order-linked upload channel. Do not unpack it if unsafe. The merchant will assess the evidence before deciding a remedy.

later_events.body: The two requested image views are submitted: [full carton](attachments/carton-overview.png) and [corner detail](attachments/carton-detail.png). These files are explicitly labelled synthetic rendered scene simulations for this fictional exercise, not actual customer photographs.
We received both requested views for TG-021 / DL-021 at 09:55 UTC. They are sufficient to open the packaging-damage assessment. Contents condition and compensation have not been decided.
